seo.title: FP Live: Fintech Events and Meetups in Pakistan
seo.description: Monthly fintech meetups, closed-door roundtables and the Rails Summit in Lahore, the flagship stage for the people behind Pakistan's financial rails.

hero.title: Events and meetups
hero.lede: The community meets in person. Small, regular meetups keep people connected, and one flagship stage brings the whole ecosystem together.

summit.name: The Rails Summit
summit.text: Our flagship event on the infrastructure under Pakistan's money: payments, remittances and the systems that connect them. Sponsorship and speaking slots are open.

formats.heading: Formats
formats.intro: Each format has a different job, from keeping people in touch to putting the whole ecosystem on one stage.

cards.label: Monthly
cards.title: Meetups
cards.text: Informal evenings for founders and operators to meet the people they've been messaging. Open to community members.

cards.label: Closed door
cards.title: Roundtables
cards.text: Small, focused sessions on a single problem, with the people who own it. By invitation.

cards.label: Flagship
cards.title: The Rails Summit
cards.text: One day, one stage, the whole ecosystem. Talks, panels and the people behind Pakistan's financial rails.

host.heading: Host an event
host.text: Host a meetup at your office, sponsor a roundtable on the problem you solve, or partner on the Rails Summit.
host.cardLabel: Running your own fintech event in Pakistan?
host.cardText: Tell us about it and we'll share it with the community.
